description: This file implements a cache system for self-chat messages in the BlueBubbles project, including functions for normalization, hashing, cache management, and lookup handling.

methods.name: normalizeBody
methods.description: Normalizes the message body by trimming and limiting length.

methods.name: isUsableTimestamp
methods.description: Checks if a timestamp is a finite number.

methods.name: digestText
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of the text and encodes it in base64url.

methods.name: trimOrUndefined
methods.description: Trims a string or returns undefined if null or empty.

methods.name: resolveCanonicalChatTarget
methods.description: Resolves the chat target handle from chat GUID or identifier.

methods.name: buildScope
methods.description: Builds a scope string based on account ID and chat target.

methods.name: cleanupExpired
methods.description: Removes expired cache entries based on TTL.

methods.name: enforceSizeCap
methods.description: Ensures cache size does not exceed maximum entries.

methods.name: buildKey
methods.description: Constructs a cache key from lookup data if valid.
